detail: ocentra_enforcer_coordination_claim reported MCP server stale/reload-required; CLI fallback via scripts/rust-rules.mjs coordination claim hit ENOENT on .ledger/ocentra-parent/identity/node.json, and 'coordination mail --action send' returned unknown command: mail. Logged and proceeded directly to the workpack per protocol (hub best-effort, do not block).

arc-23 had not yet created crates/enforcer-install/src/adapters.rs or src/emitters.rs (the pub-mod barrels) or their lib.rs mod declarations, despite the crate skeleton documenting them as mount points. Created both as minimal additive pub-mod-only files (no pub use re-export, so [workspace.lints] pub-use-barrel restriction does not apply) so generic.rs/doctor.rs/consumer_ci.rs/git_hooks.rs have somewhere to live. Follows the same fallback precedent c02 used for HarnessId.

Added enforcer-mcp as a dependency of enforcer-install (Cargo.toml) so the generic adapter can consume enforcer_mcp::name::SERVER_NAME (the x01 const, already landed as "enforcer") instead of hardcoding the mcpServers key literal. Cargo.toml is not in c07's owns: line; additive one-line edit, no cycle (enforcer-mcp does not depend on enforcer-install). Flagged for arc-23/hub review.

Reference bundled templates under adapters/github-actions/*.yml and adapters/{git-hooks,husky,lefthook}/* still contain the pre-x01-rename 'ocentra-enforcer' literal (npm package name / CLI invocation / env var prefixes). Emitted verbatim (golden-bytes contract requires byte-identical emission from the bundled templates) rather than silently rewritten. Flagged as a follow-up for whichever pack owns the x01-cutover content edit of these template files.

cargo test -p enforcer-install --lib failed with os error 740 (elevation required) on the enforcer_install-<hash>.exe test binary -- the known L29 Windows UAC installer-detection heuristic firing on the *install* filename substring. Mitigated per L29 with __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker for the test run; tests then ran clean.

97/97 cargo test -p enforcer-install pass (74 baseline + 23 new: generic adapter 8, doctor 5, consumer_ci emitter 6, git_hooks emitter 6 minus overlap); clippy -p enforcer-install --all-targets clean; fmt clean. Full cargo test --workspace --lib also green across all 25 crates (no regressions). Proof artifact written to proof/install/c07-generic.json; TEST_PROOF_EXPECTATIONS.md c07 rows (generic-writer, install-doctor, consumer-ci-emitter, git-hooks-emitter) set GREEN.
